title: A uniform pluricanonical Iitaka degree
exact_target: For each $d\geq 1$, does there exist a positive m(d) such that $|m(d)K_X|$ gives the entire Iitaka fibration of every smooth integral projective d-fold of nonnegative Kodaira dimension over every algebraically closed characteristic-zero field? The ratios must generate the Iitaka field, rather than merely attain its transcendence degree.
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For each $d\geq 1$, does there exist a positive m(d) such that $|m(d)K_X|$ gives the entire Iitaka fibration of every smooth integral projective d-fold of nonnegative Kodaira dimension over every algebraically closed characteristic-zero field? The ratios must generate the Iitaka field, rather than merely attain its transcendence degree.

\subsection{Short English statement}
For each $d\geq 1$, does there exist a positive m(d) such that $|m(d)K_X|$ gives the entire Iitaka fibration of every smooth integral projective d-fold of nonnegative Kodaira dimension over every algebraically closed characteristic-zero field? The ratios must generate the Iitaka field, rather than merely attain its transcendence degree.
